2025-07-07.riddle: I zip and store, I carry tight, From pencils dull to pens that write. You take me to your desk or class— What am I?
2025-07-07.hint: I’m a little bag for all your stuff.

2025-07-08.riddle: I open books and turn each page, I’m used by readers of every age. With corners square or curved just right— What am I?
2025-07-08.hint: You use me to flip through stories.

2025-07-09.riddle: I shine in the dark, I’m worn with care, On camping trips or anywhere. I fit your head, but I’m not a hat— What am I?

2025-07-10.riddle: I hold your drink when you’re on the go, I keep it hot or cold, you know. With twist-on lids and plastic walls— What am I?
2025-07-10.hint: You sip from me all day long.

2025-07-11.riddle: I’m full of knowledge, thick or thin, I start with covers, end within. I live on shelves and love to teach— What am I?

2025-07-12.riddle: I race but never move alone, My wheels all spin, my frame is shown. With handlebars and pedals too— What am I?
2025-07-12.hint: I roll through parks and streets with you.

2025-07-13.riddle: I float on water, made to row, I move where gentle rivers flow. I carry one or maybe two— What am I?
2025-07-13.hint: I glide on lakes with just a paddle.

2025-07-14.riddle: I open locks but not with teeth, I twist in holes and turn beneath. I’m often kept on heavy rings— What am I?
